async function addItemToCart(itemId: string, quantity: number, userData: any) {

      quantity: quantity,
      user: userData,
      action: "add_to_cart"
    });
    console.log("Add to Cart Response:", response);
    return response;

    console.error("Error adding item to cart:", error);
    return null;
